newsitem.title: USA: Natl hurricane center sizes up potential new storm.
newsitem.headline: Natl hurricane center sizes up potential new storm.

text.p: The National Hurricane Center said Friday that it is assessing another area of disturbed weather near Honduras which is expected to move west and may become a tropical depression.

"There is an area of disturbed weather near central America, near the Yucatan peninsula. It is outside the Gulf of Honduras (and) is...expected to move westward at 10 miles per hour," said Tricia Wallace of the NHC.
The NHC will send a reconnaissance aircraft this afternoon and will await its return before assessing whether it is a tropical depression.

Tropical storm Josephine swept up through the Gulf of Mexico earlier this week causing disruptions to oil shipping and operations resulting in an estimated 600,000 barrels of lost production, according to oil traders.
Josephine hit Florida's northern Gulf coast on Tueday and caused widespread damage.
